compiled_state.title: UPDATE: add --metrics flag to review-stats.py + playbook doc section
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Expose the 4 new metric functions in review-stats.py via a --metrics CLI flag, computing them over rolling 7-day and 30-day windows. Add playbook documentation inline.

## Changes
1. review-stats.py: add '--metrics' arg to argparse; when passed, compute and print table:
   - p90_cycle_count (7-day and 30-day)
   - phantom_escalation_rate (7-day and 30-day)
   - call2_finding_drop_rate (7-day and 30-day)
   - prior_region_resustain_skew (7-day and 30-day)
   Filter events by timestamp for each window.
2. Add playbook section as a docstring or inline comment:
   - phantom_escalation_rate > 0.3 for 2 consecutive 7-day windows -> open P2 bug against cycle-1 severity rubric
   - prior_region_resustain_skew > 3.0 for 2 consecutive windows -> investigate proximity-overlap false positives

## Acceptance Criteria
- python3 plugins/dso/scripts/review-stats.py --metrics runs without error
- grep -q 'phantom_escalation_rate' plugins/dso/scripts/review-stats.py (already done)
- make lint passes
